source_title: Japan Officially Confirms Its Best Manga Of The Year
source_excerpt:
The manga industry that's rooted in Japan has grown tremendously over the years and has now become a global phenomenon. Despite that, most manga sales still come from the home country. Every year, fans get a list of the most sold manga, including both new and old series, which helps them gauge which series is on the rise and what experiences a drop-off. Not all manga series are equally popular, and only a few have established themselves as legendary, with impressive sales figures to back them up.
While 2026 is nearing its end, we finally have the full figures for Japanese manga sales of 2025, which were revealed fully earlier this month. To no one's surprise, Japan's highest-selling manga of all time, One Piece , established itself as the number one bestseller of the year. One Piece is set to continue on this trend in 2026 and possibly 2027.
One Piece Dominates In Japan With Highest 2025 Sales, New Report Reveals
Manga sales are the most effective way to assess how a series is doing in Japan. The most accurate numbers concerning these sales come to us directly from Oricon. Oricon Inc. was founded in 1999, and it remains, even today, the most reliable source to acquire the average number of sales of manga series over any set period of time.
2026's end is already around the corner. However, for the most accurate manga sales numbers, it often takes a while to get the final score. That is why on October 22, 2026, Oricon released its official numbers concerning the best-selling series in Japan in the year 2025. This might seem quite late, but the tally certainly takes its time, and now, we have an accurate picture in front of us. To be specific, the new numbers released cover sales recorded between November 18, 2024, and November 14, 2025. This new chart specifically reveals the top 200 best-selling series in the country. Finally, we know exactly which series has dominated in the last year.
It doesn't come as a surprise to anyone to see One Piece, a legendary series by Eiichiro Oda, take the top spot. One Piece is known globally as the highest-selling manga of all time, currently sitting at cumulative sales of over 600 million . In 2025, it achieved 4,211,363 sales, which is over 400k more than the number 2 series. To many, it's a no-brainer to see One Piece take the number one spot, as it does have the most sales overall. However, it must be said that until 2025, One Piece had failed to take the number one spot for five years in a row.
One Piece's decline started in 2019 with the rise of Demon Slayer, and it didn't win the number one spot for a while because of series like Jujutsu Kaisen and Blue Lock surpassing it. This has, however, changed now. One Piece's Elbaf arc has made a big difference, and the fall of some of its competitors the year before, like Jujutsu Kaisen and My Hero Academia, has guaranteed its success.
It's exciting to see One Piece back at the top with new 2025 numbers revealed by Oricon. Now, with 2026 almost over, we are more curious about which series will make it to the top at the end of this year. Oricon will only reveal the official cumulative numbers for this year in 2027. However, the gap is so large between the number one and the number two series that it's already quite clear who is making it out on top.
Following its resurgence in 2025, One Piece is once again going to claim the top spot this year. The latest numbers for One Piece indicate the series has already sold over 3.1 million copies, based on the latest Oricon report from August 3, 2026 sales. This number was achieved with only three volumes out, those being Volumes 113, 114, and 115. There is no other series at the moment with numbers even comparable. In other words, it is a guarantee at the moment that One Piece will be Japan's number one best-selling manga series in 2026 as well.
Second and third spots are likely to go to Gege Akutami's Jujutsu Kaisen, which was also second last year, and Frieren, whose manga backlog sales have been booming after the release of its second season in January.

One Piece Will Remain as The Best Selling Manga Until More Competition Arises
Many fans believed One Piece was in a free fall after its decline began in 2019. With the rise of Demon Slayer, its title of bestseller of the year was snatched away. However, since 2025, it's clear that One Piece is regaining its popularity in Japan. This isn't necessarily because manga sales have exploded. Since 2019, One Piece sales have been rather constant, with every volume averaging a little over 1 million sales.
The true reason why One Piece is such a dominating force at the moment is due to the lack of competition. Gege Akutami's Jujutsu Kaisen ended in 2024, and even though Modulo returned in 2025 and 2026, it was a short series and ended after 3 volumes. Other big competitors, like Demon Slayer, have also long ended, leaving One Piece as one of the last remaining pillars of Weekly Shonen Jump and manga in general.
The truth is, One Piece is unlikely to be dethroned for quite some time. There are no new series with the potential to surpass Oda’s One Piece. The only series that could soon come in and swoop away the top spot from One Piece is an already highly established and famous manga, Naruto.
Since the big reveal of its impending return on October 10, 2026, fans are eagerly waiting to see Naruto return to Jump and compete with One Piece once more. Kishimoto recently revealed that he is planning to return with a new manga titled Naruto: Shadow Rising . This manga doesn't yet have an official return date, but more information is set to come out at Jump Festa 2027, which will be taking place on December 19, 2026. The nostalgia and popularity that Naruto holds are comparable to those of One Piece. After years of absence, Naruto manga sales will blow up again.
Other possible competitors could come from a potential return of Gege Akutami with a new Jujutsu Kaisen story . Out of the new generation, the only series that could rise to the top is Kagurabachi, but it's hard to say how popular the series will become until its anime releases in 2027. It could become the next Jujutsu Kaisen or Demon Slayer and compete with the big manga for the top spot.
